sc4500@3.90/outputs.modbus_rs232_rs485.m.label: Modbus mode

sc4500@3.90/outputs.modbus_rs232_rs485.d.label: Data order

phd_sc@unknown/device_menu.configure.label: Configure
phd_sc@unknown/device_menu.configure.description: Select a sensor name and type of sensor; change options for measurement, calibration, data handling and storage.

phd_sc@unknown/device_menu.configure.nam.label: Name
phd_sc@unknown/device_menu.configure.nam.description: Changes the name displayed at the top of the measurement screen; limited to 12 characters (letters, numbers, spaces or punctuation).

phd_sc@unknown/device_menu.configure.sel.label: Select sensor
phd_sc@unknown/device_menu.configure.sel.description: Selects the type of sensor (pH or ORP).

phd_sc@unknown/device_menu.configure.for.label: Format
phd_sc@unknown/device_menu.configure.for.description: For pH sensors only—changes the number of decimal places shown on the measurement screen to XX.XX (default) or XX.X.

phd_sc@unknown/device_menu.configure.tem.label: Temperature
phd_sc@unknown/device_menu.configure.tem.description: Sets the temperature units to °C (default) or °F.

phd_sc@unknown/device_menu.configure.dat.label: Data logger interval
phd_sc@unknown/device_menu.configure.dat.description: Sets the time interval for data storage in the data log—Disabled, 5, 10, 15, 30 seconds, 1, 5, 10, 15 (default), 30 minutes, 1, 2, 6, 12 hours.

phd_sc@unknown/device_menu.configure.ac_.label: Alternating current frequency
phd_sc@unknown/device_menu.configure.ac_.description: Selects the frequency of the AC power supplied to the controller (50 or 60 Hz).

phd_sc@unknown/device_menu.configure.fil.label: Filter
phd_sc@unknown/device_menu.configure.fil.description: Sets a time constant (0 to 60 seconds) to calculate an average value and increase signal stability; 0 = no effect (default).

phd_sc@unknown/device_menu.configure.tem.label: Temperature element
phd_sc@unknown/device_menu.configure.tem.description: pH sensors—sets the temperature element for automatic temperature compensation to PT100, PT1000, NTC300 (default) or Manual; ORP sensors—a temperature element can be connected to measure temperature only.

phd_sc@unknown/device_menu.configure.sel.label: Select standard buffer
phd_sc@unknown/device_menu.configure.sel.description: For pH sensors only—selects the buffer solutions used for calibration: pH 4, 7, 10 (default) or DIN 19267.

phd_sc@unknown/device_menu.configure.pur.label: Pure H2O compensation
phd_sc@unknown/device_menu.configure.pur.description: For pH sensors only—adds a temperature-dependent correction for pure water with additives: None (default), Ammonia, Morpholine, Pure water, User defined, or 1–4-point matrix correction.

phd_sc@unknown/device_menu.configure.las.label: Last calibration
phd_sc@unknown/device_menu.configure.las.description: Sets a reminder interval (default: 60 days) for the next calibration; a reminder appears on the display after the selected number of days from the last calibration date.

phd_sc@unknown/device_menu.configure.sen.label: Sensor days
phd_sc@unknown/device_menu.configure.sen.description: Sets the sensor replacement interval (default: 365 days); a warning appears when the sensor has been in operation longer than this interval.

phd_sc@unknown/device_menu.configure.imp.label: Impedance limits
phd_sc@unknown/device_menu.configure.imp.description: Sets the low (default: 0 MΩ) and high (default: 1000 MΩ) impedance limits for the active and reference electrodes.

phd_sc@unknown/device_menu.configure.res.label: Reset setup
phd_sc@unknown/device_menu.configure.res.description: Sets all sensor settings back to factory defaults and resets counters; all device information is lost.

phd_sc@unknown/device_menu.calibrate.ph_.label: 1-point auto correction
phd_sc@unknown/device_menu.calibrate.ph_.description: Uses one buffer (e.g., pH 7); the sensor automatically identifies the buffer during calibration.

phd_sc@unknown/device_menu.calibrate.ph_.label: 2-point auto correction
phd_sc@unknown/device_menu.calibrate.ph_.description: Uses two buffers (e.g., pH 7 and pH 4); the sensor automatically identifies the buffers during calibration (recommended).

phd_sc@unknown/device_menu.calibrate.ph_.label: 1-point manual correction
phd_sc@unknown/device_menu.calibrate.ph_.description: Uses a sample of known pH value or one buffer; the user enters the pH value during calibration.

phd_sc@unknown/device_menu.calibrate.ph_.label: 2-point manual correction
phd_sc@unknown/device_menu.calibrate.ph_.description: Uses two samples of known pH value or two buffers; the user enters the pH values during calibration.

phd_sc@unknown/device_menu.calibrate.orp.label: 1-point manual correction
phd_sc@unknown/device_menu.calibrate.orp.description: Calibrates the ORP sensor against one reference solution or sample of known value; the user enters the ORP value during calibration.

phd_sc@unknown/device_menu.calibrate.tem.label: Temperature adjustment
phd_sc@unknown/device_menu.calibrate.tem.description: Calibrates the temperature reading against an accurate external thermometer by entering the exact measured temperature value.

phd_sc@unknown/device_menu.calibrate.exi.label: Cancel
phd_sc@unknown/device_menu.calibrate.exi.description: Stops the calibration; a new calibration must start from the beginning.

phd_sc@unknown/device_menu.calibrate.exi.label: Exit
phd_sc@unknown/device_menu.calibrate.exi.description: Exits the calibration temporarily; access to other menus is allowed and a calibration for a second sensor (if present) can be started.

phd_sc@unknown/device_menu.calibrate.fac.label: Reset setup
phd_sc@unknown/device_menu.calibrate.fac.description: Sets the sensor back to the factory calibration values.

phd_sc@unknown/device_menu.diagnostics.label: Diagnostics
phd_sc@unknown/device_menu.diagnostics.description: Access sensor diagnostic information and test readings.

phd_sc@unknown/device_menu.diagnostics.s.label: Sensor information
phd_sc@unknown/device_menu.diagnostics.s.description: Shows the sensor type, name, serial number, software version and driver version.

phd_sc@unknown/device_menu.diagnostics.c.label: Calibration history
phd_sc@unknown/device_menu.diagnostics.c.description: Shows the pH slope (mV/pH) and date of the last calibration; the pH slope should be 55 to 61 mV/pH.

phd_sc@unknown/device_menu.diagnostics.s.label: Sensor signal
phd_sc@unknown/device_menu.diagnostics.s.description: Shows the sensor reading in mV; the mV range is –60 to +60 mV (0 mV = pH 7).

phd_sc@unknown/device_menu.diagnostics.s.label: Measurement analog to digital converter counter
phd_sc@unknown/device_menu.diagnostics.s.description: Shows the digital number that represents the pH or ORP reading.

phd_sc@unknown/device_menu.diagnostics.s.label: Temperature analog to digital converter counter
phd_sc@unknown/device_menu.diagnostics.s.description: Shows the digital number that represents the temperature reading.

phd_sc@unknown/device_menu.diagnostics.s.label: Impedance status
phd_sc@unknown/device_menu.diagnostics.s.description: When set to Enabled (recommended), measures active and reference electrode impedance at 1-minute intervals and shows an error when impedance is outside the configured limits.

phd_sc@unknown/device_menu.diagnostics.c.label: Sensor days
phd_sc@unknown/device_menu.diagnostics.c.description: Shows the number of days the sensor has been in operation.

phd_sc@unknown/device_menu.diagnostics.c.label: Reset
phd_sc@unknown/device_menu.diagnostics.c.description: Sets the Sensor days and Electrode days values to zero.

phd_sc@unknown/device_menu.diagnostics.c.label: Electrode days
phd_sc@unknown/device_menu.diagnostics.c.description: Shows the number of days since the salt bridge was replaced; automatically reset to zero when the salt bridge is replaced.

phD-ORP@3.4/diagnostics.sensor_status.label: Sensor Status
phD-ORP@3.4/diagnostics.sensor_status.description: Current operational status of the sensor.

phD-ORP@3.4/diagnostics.uptime.label: Uptime
phD-ORP@3.4/diagnostics.uptime.description: Total operating time since last reset.
